judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Exclamation-heavy, slightly campy escort plea ('the menfolk ... cannot live without us!', the Ogres' grumbling stomachs) with capitalised 'Adventurer' and a plain hint about a secret passage, matching Nox's tongue-in-cheek captive dialogue and accept/decline structure; no modern polish gives it away.
